title: studio(publish): a rolled-back publish never shows its "Nothing was published" banner — formatPublishFailures compares code to 'batch_aborted' while the producer emits 'BATCH_ABORTED'
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, class (a), a user-visible wrong result with a named producer, measured through the renderer. Reader: objectui triage first-touch (grade and route). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU`, account `os-bill`), from the objectui#11922 dev report (`6063184163`, out-of-scope finding 1). The seat re-read both ends on objectstack `51290bca` and objectui `main` `989b19082`.

Seam: spec:`PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.failed[].code` (SCREAMING_SNAKE) → renderer:`formatPublishFailures` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts`)

## What happens

- **The producer:** objectstack `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `publishPackageDrafts`. When a batch fails, every draft that rolled back with it is answered with `code: 'BATCH_ABORTED'`, upper case. The causal item carries its own error.
- **The renderer:** `formatPublishFailures` declares `BATCH_ABORTED_CODE = 'batch_aborted'` and compares `f.code === BATCH_ABORTED_CODE`, which is case-sensitive. The upper-case code never matches.
- **So:**
  - the branch that prints "Nothing was published — the batch rolled back (all-or-nothing).", leads with the cause and counts the aborted siblings never runs;
  - the author gets one parallel line per draft instead: the cause, then each sibling's "not published — the batch is all-or-nothing … the transaction rolled back".
- **Callers:**
  - Studio's publish, both toast branches in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`'s `doPublish`, the refused branch included since objectui#11916;
  - the AI chat page's publish summary (`AiChatPage.tsx`).
- **Measured:** the objectui#11922 dev ran `formatPublishFailures` on the producer's rollback shape: a causal `object/lead` plus two `BATCH_ABORTED` siblings. It printed three parallel lines and no banner.
- **Why CI is green:** `metadataError.test.ts` pins the lower-case fixture, so it never sees the producer's spelling.

## Expected

A rolled-back publish leads with the banner and its cause, and counts the aborted drafts, whatever case the code is spelled in.

`@object-ui/types` already ships `errorCodeIs(err, code)`, which compares codes ignoring case. objectui#11922's PR objectui#11983 uses it for the package sheet and Home's *Publish all*.

## Reach

- **Named producer:** `publishPackageDrafts`'s rollback return, read at objectstack `51290bca`.
- **Not measured at a public door in a browser:** the renderer was measured on the producer's shape.

## Duplicate check

- MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open and closed:
  - "formatPublishFailures batch_aborted casing BATCH_ABORTED rolled back banner Studio publish" returned 6 hits, none the same defect. The nearest are objectui#11922 (the package sheet and Home doors, a different file) and #11591 (closed, a different publish topic).
  - "publish rollback all-or-nothing banner missing siblings shown as parallel errors metadataError" returned 0 hits.
- **Positive control:** the first query returns objectui#11922, the sibling publish-refusal card, so the population is searchable.

Dedupe words: formatPublishFailures batch_aborted casing · BATCH_ABORTED rolled back banner Studio publish · metadataError errorCodeIs
